title: FC A02: Training Schools
officialText:
A02.1 Training school accreditation fees.

Applicants for training school accreditation required pursuant to the provisions of this code or the rules shall pay the fees specified in this section. All accreditation fees are per year, unless otherwise indicated.

Fee

1.FLS director and FEP Coordinator training school

Original application

$2,940.00

Renewal application

$420.00

2.Refrigeration and related technology training school

Original application

$2,940.00

Renewal application

$420.00

3.Construction site fire safety manager training schools

Original application

$2,940.00

Renewal application

$420.00

4.Continuing education training schools, including training schools for building operation, maintenance and recordkeeping, and active shooter and medical emergency preparedness

Original application

$2,940.00

Renewal application

$420.00
